description: This Scala source file defines the MLCache class used for caching machine learning models and summaries within Apache Spark's connect module. It manages in-memory and offloaded storage, cache size limits, and resource cleanup.

classes.name: MLCache
classes.description: A class for caching ML models and summaries, managing in-memory and disk storage, with size control and cleanup.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Caches a model or summary object and returns its reference ID.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a cached object by its reference ID.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a cached object by its reference ID.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all cached models and summaries.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Cleans up resources, called during session cleanup.

methods.name: checkModelSize
methods.description: Checks if a model size exceeds cache limits.

methods.name: estimateObjectSize
methods.description: Estimates the size of a model object.

methods.name: verifyObjectId
methods.description: Verifies if a reference ID is a valid UUID.

methods.name: getModelOffloadingPath
methods.description: Gets the disk path for offloaded models.

methods.name: _removeModel
methods.description: Removes a model from cache and disk if applicable.
